attack.note: Might of the Nerazim, Master Warp-Blade, Mending Strikes and Psionic Strength all reward weaving autos between abilities. Singularity Spike is his only ranged ability and is usually cast from melee.

poke.note: Singularity Spike can be fired from range but the guide says to avoid using it as poke because it is easy to heal off and a long cooldown.

damage.note: Cleave, Singularity Spike with a slow and weaved autos burst a squishy target in a couple of seconds, and Twilight Falls doubles the rotation. Mending Strikes lets him out sustain weak healers in 1v1. Burst gets through healing, but a fully healed and shielded target (Medivh, Uther, Divine Shield) survives.

good_into.why: Permanent Cloak, Blink and Vorpal Blade reach the backline unseen and Cleave plus Singularity Spike plus Might of the Nerazim kill it fast.
Stealth flanks bypass the front line, and Void Prison can split the enemy team in half so allies fight only the backline.
Mending Strikes and Shadow Mending beat weak healers in a duel and burst kills before an Uther or Morales heal lands.
Move Unseen gives fast stealth rotations and ganks on lone heroes, and Void Prison can freeze a camp or a structure.

bad_into.why: Targeted CC (Polymorph, Twilight Dream, Warlord's Challenge) hits him in the Wormhole window or after he commits, and he has low health.
Revealing abilities such as Eye of Kilrogg or area damage strip his main strength and leave a fragile hero exposed.
He is easy to kill once revealed and relies on cooldown timing for Blink, so he cannot trade with a dive comp.
Heroes who can react to Blink with their own gap closer leave him with no reliable follow up if Vorpal Blade fails.

wants_from_team: Combo partners for Void Prison (Diablo, Jaina)
Early game strength since he is weak early
gives_team: Void Prison setup for team combos or a split
weaknesses: Vulnerable to targeted crowd control and reveals
Low base health for a melee assassin
Weak early game, depends on Level 16 talents
evidence: Permanent Cloak, Blink, Vorpal Blade, Singularity Spike, Cleave
Might of the Nerazim and Void Prison heroics
Wormhole, Seeker in the Dark, Mending Strikes, Master Warp-Blade, Twilight Falls talents
Icy Veins guide: vulnerable to targeted CC, weak early, great ganker
